validation.structuralUnitTests: candidate suite includes dedicated cross-workspace unverified-export safety assertions; hosted main remains authoritative for PDF.js checksum bytes
validation.browserRegressionScripts: 24 configured Chromium regressions; optional Firefox/WebKit matrix remains available; native Safari/iPadOS requires physical-device validation
validation.dedicatedV0202RecoveryRegression: extended: save -> unverified download retains dirty/recovery -> continue editing -> restore -> re-export fidelity
validation.presentationsControlRegression: extended: Format/notes/thumbnails plus slideshow current/start entry, keyboard navigation, Escape/Exit and compact drawer behavior
validation.functionalAcceptanceInventory: Visible controls are frozen for 1.0 beta; the low-value generic Launcher file handoff has been removed, while each workspace retains its own explicit Open flow.
validation.interactiveDomContracts: duplicate ids and unresolved direct app control references checked across six workspaces
validation.v02021FunctionalCorrectionsRegression: configured: Home cleanup, PDF note removal, editable Spreadsheet/Presentation titles, TXT/EPUB 44px titlebars
validation.architectureGuardrails: required: no feature expansion during 1.0 beta preparation; data-safety, formula, recovery and package-preservation guardrails remain enforced.
validation.presentationsModularization: selection/history, Inspector, thumbnails, presenter notes, slideshow, PPTX write adapter, file I/O and recovery lifecycle are isolated in focused components; app.js remains the presentation/editor orchestration entry point
validation.pdfRenderingModularization: page virtualization, canvas/text/AcroForm rendering, render-window disposal and resize rerender remain isolated in apps/pdf/viewer/page-renderer.js
validation.pdfNavigationModularization: page navigation, page-list thumbnails, outline destinations, bookmark navigation and sidebar tab state are isolated in apps/pdf/viewer/navigation-controller.js
validation.pdfReviewModularization: review persistence, selected-text highlight/underline/comment, free marker/text annotations, comment list rendering and undo are isolated in apps/pdf/review/review-controller.js plus annotation-layer.js
validation.pdfSaveModularization: unannotated PDF.js saveDocument and annotated flattened export coordination are isolated in apps/pdf/io/save-controller.js; app.js only composes availability with document lifecycle
validation.sharedDocumentSessionModularization: filename normalization, dirty-state bridging, discard warnings and download-name rewriting are isolated in shared/ui/document-session-controller.js; office-shell now composes the controller with file lifecycle
validation.sharedWorkspacePanelModularization: Documents/Presentations/PDF panel state, Spreadsheet layout markers, workspace module detection, session preference resolution and layout-ready notification are isolated in shared/ui/workspace-panel-controller.js
validation.documentsRulerModelModularization: pure ruler geometry and indent-state helpers remain isolated in shared/ui/document-ruler-model.js; workspace-layout.js delegates calculations without owning them
validation.documentsRulerDragModularization: ruler pointerdown/move/up/cancel lifecycle, pointer capture, drag-state transitions and indentation application orchestration live in shared/ui/document-ruler-drag-controller.js; workspace-layout.js retains ruler DOM synchronization and observers
validation.workspaceLayoutContractConsolidation: workspace-layout.js delegates shared workspace contract helpers to workspace-panel-controller.js while preserving InkDOSWorkspaceLayout moduleId/resolvedPreference/defaults compatibility and Documents ruler behavior
validation.txtInteractionModularization: Undo/Redo snapshot history and find-bar behavior are isolated in apps/txt/history-controller.js and apps/txt/find-controller.js while app.js retains TXT file lifecycle, encoding, save, counts and display controls
validation.spreadsheetFormulaModelModularization: function catalog, cell/reference encoding, parenthesis tracking, formula balancing, suggestion matching/insertion and reference/commit predicates are isolated in apps/spreadsheets/formula-model.js; InkDOSFormulaEditor helper API remains compatible
validation.spreadsheetFormulaSessionModularization: persistent draft Map plus start/update/suspend/resume/commit-preparation/cancel-preparation transitions are isolated in apps/spreadsheets/formula-session.js and covered by DOM-free lifecycle tests
validation.spreadsheetFormulaDraftSafety: pending formula drafts are guarded across Save/New/Open/before-unload; confirmed replacement resets drafts only after a replacement workbook parses successfully
validation.spreadsheetHistorySafety: Undo/Redo actions retain their originating worksheet, workbook recalculation follows history restore, pending formula drafts guard history mutation, and recovery schema v3 preserves bounded Undo/Redo state
validation.spreadsheetExportConfirmationSafety: recovery flush precedes XLSX download dispatch; unverified download requests retain dirty state and snapshots until explicit replacement/discard
validation.documentsReplacementSafety: dirty Documents Open requires explicit confirmation; cancellation and parse failure preserve the active unsaved DOCX
validation.crossWorkspaceExportSafety: Documents and Presentations flush pending recovery before download dispatch and retain dirty/recovery state; TXT uses the shared download-requested-unverified lifecycle; Spreadsheet strict policy remains unchanged
validation.visualFoundation: shared/ui/visual.css is loaded last by Home and all six workspaces; runtime/editor logic remains unchanged apart from release identity/cache metadata
validation.contentWorkspacesVisual: shared/ui/content.css is loaded after the v0.20.3.0 visual foundation and targets only Documents, TXT and EPUB; editor/runtime logic remains unchanged apart from release/cache metadata
validation.spreadsheetVisualRefinement: last-loaded spreadsheet-only visual overlay refines formula-bar hierarchy, grid/header selection emphasis, persistent worksheet Add/Delete controls and compact status/zoom treatment without changing formula, recovery, history or package-preserving XLS/XLSX behavior

releasePolicy: Feature freeze: only reproducible integrity, compatibility or high-value low-risk corrections should change runtime before 1.0 stable.
